$comment: Which lane owns which path (card P0-08.2; read by tools/factory/lane-check.sh, the lane names also by tools/factory/lane.sh and tools/monitor/card.py). Two pattern rules: a pattern ending in '/' owns the paths that start with it; any other pattern owns the one path equal to it. No globs and no precedence: a path matched by patterns of two lanes, or by none, is an error that lane-check.sh names.
